notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Humans.
description:
Activate Horn of Gondor by paying {3} and tapping it.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers. Choose not to pay.
Resolve the Horn of Gondor trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens equal to the number of Humans you control.
When the Humans enter the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers that many times.
Resolve a Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Human and/or Soldier you control.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining trigger.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Horn of Gondor.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Horn of Gondor.
Repeat.
